subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should detailed Cursor usage-event history be fetched whenever the existing Cursor session and global cost summary are enabled, or only after a separate Cursor-specific opt-in?
rationale: The implementation can reuse existing authentication safely, but repository behavior and docs do not establish that consent for summary status access also authorizes detailed account-wide event-history collection and billing-like estimates.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a Cursor-specific consent setting that defaults off for existing users and clearly describes the remote account-wide history request.

options.title: Reuse existing consent
options.body: Explicitly approve the configured Cursor cookie source plus global cost-summary setting as sufficient authorization for detailed history retrieval.

options.title: Decline detailed history
options.body: Keep Cursor limited to its current summary status integration and close this feature direction.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a Cursor-specific consent setting that defaults off for existing users and clearly describes the remote account-wide history request.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner owns the current Cursor session path and explicitly retained this exact product/privacy decision after technical review.
